description: Collect Zomato restaurants, full menus, reviews, photos, offers and contact details across India and the UAE. Search a city, paste any Zomato URL, or paste numeric restaurant IDs. No login, cookies or proxy setup.

city.description: Used with Search and Collections when you do not paste a listing URL. All cities where Zomato currently publishes restaurant data.
city.sectionDescription: Used when you search by city instead of pasting a listing URL.
city.title: City

cuisine.description: Narrow the city search to one cuisine. Choose Any to keep every cuisine.
cuisine.title: Cuisine

cuisineSlug.description: Optional free-form cuisine, e.g. 'chinese' or '1051'. Overrides the Cuisine dropdown when set.
cuisineSlug.title: Custom cuisine ID or slug

expandCollections.description: For a city search, also read the city's curated collections. Each collection page can expose dozens of restaurants.
expandCollections.title: Fan out across collections

expandCuisines.description: For a city search, also read one listing per popular cuisine (20 extra listings). Multiplies coverage because Zomato shows only 9 rows per listing.
expandCuisines.title: Fan out across popular cuisines

ignoreUrlFailures.description: Keep going when one URL or restaurant cannot be read.
ignoreUrlFailures.title: Continue on failures

includeDetails.description: Fetch each restaurant's detail page for phones, coordinates, hours, offers, payments, chain and more. Turn off for a faster, cheaper run.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: These toggles also work on Search, Collections and Restaurant modes.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full restaurant details

includeMenu.description: Attach menu items to each restaurant row (Search/Collections/Restaurant) or return one row per dish in Menu mode.
includeMenu.title: Include menu

includeMenuImages.description: When a restaurant only publishes menu photos, keep the image page URLs.
includeMenuImages.title: Include menu image pages

includePhotos.description: Attach gallery photos to each restaurant row or return flat photo rows in Photos mode.
includePhotos.title: Include photo gallery

includeReviews.description: Attach reviews to each restaurant row (Search/Collections/Restaurant) or return flat review rows in Reviews mode.
includeReviews.title: Include reviews

maxCost.description: Drop restaurants whose published cost for two is above this amount. Leave 0 for no upper bound.
maxCost.title: Maximum cost for two

maxItems.description: Hard cap on returned rows. A negative input is clamped. Search returns restaurants; Reviews, Menu and Photos return their own record type.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Keep the daily test small; raise these only for real runs.
maxItems.title: Max records

maxPhotosPerRestaurant.description: 0 means every photo Zomato exposes (guarded at 5,000). Photos are paginated 30 per request.
maxPhotosPerRestaurant.title: Max photos per restaurant

maxRetries.description: Retries per request on 429, 5xx and connection errors.
maxRetries.title: Max retries

maxReviewsPerRestaurant.description: 0 means every review Zomato exposes (guarded at 10,000). Reviews are paginated 5 per request.
maxReviewsPerRestaurant.title: Max reviews per restaurant

minCost.description: Drop restaurants whose published cost for two is below this amount. Leave 0 for no lower bound.
minCost.title: Minimum cost for two

mode.description: Choose the record type you want. Search and Collections return restaurant rows; Restaurant returns one detailed row per restaurant; Reviews, Menu and Photos return one row per review, dish or photo.
enumTitles: Search by city or listing URL
mode.sectionDescription: Pick what you want, then provide a city or Zomato URLs/IDs below.
mode.title: What to collect

searchMode.description: Which Zomato city surface to read.
searchMode.title: Listing type

sort.description: Order of returned restaurant rows. Applied by Zomato where supported and again locally.
sort.title: Sort restaurants

startUrls.description: Accepts any mix of Zomato listing, locality, collection, restaurant or share URLs, plus numeric restaurant IDs. Examples: https://www.zomato.com/mumbai/restaurants, https://www.zomato.com/dubai/jones-the-grocer-al-barsha, https://www.zomato.com/mumbai/insta-worthy, 18619718.
startUrls.title: Zomato URLs or restaurant IDs

title: Zomato Restaurant, Menu & Review Data Extractor
